<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram name="两条计费路径" id="price01"> <mxGraphModel dx="-579" dy="-187" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1100" pageHeight="640" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="t" parent="1" style="text;html=1;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#1e293b;align=left;" value="同一份十万 token 历史，下一轮重发的两条计费路径" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="520" x="60" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="src" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dbeafe;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=13;" value="下一轮请求：重发十万 token 会话历史" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="240" x="60" y="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cmp" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="服务端前缀逐字节比对" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="220" x="120" y="270" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="hit" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="开头完全一致：命中" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="220" x="520" y="150" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="hitp" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dbeafe;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="折扣价 0.05 元 / 百万
实付 0.005 元" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="200" x="850" y="150" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="miss" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="中途一个字节变了：未命中" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="220" x="520" y="380" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="missp" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="原价 1.5 元 / 百万
实付 0.15 元" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="200" x="850" y="380" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="src" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;" target="cmp"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="cmp" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontSize=11;fontColor=#2563eb;" target="hit" value="一致"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="cmp" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;fontSize=11;fontColor=#64748b;" target="miss" value="有改动"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e4" edge="1" parent="1" source="hit" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#2563eb;" target="hitp"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e5" edge="1" parent="1" source="miss" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;" target="missp"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ratio" parent="1" style="text;html=1;fontSize=12;fontColor=#64748b;align=left;" value="同一份历史，两种结局差 30 倍；会话 54 轮，就是 54 次二选一" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="480" x="520" y="490" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="src2" parent="1" style="text;html=1;fontSize=12;fontColor=#64748b;align=left;" value="价目依据：DeepSeek v4-flash 输入两档，高峰时段各自翻倍、比值不动" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="520" x="60" y="560" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
